lessons.title: 1. Immutable Set Field
lessons.description: Implement `set_field(state, key, value)` returning a new dict.
lessons.solution_code:
def set_field(state, key, value):
    out = dict(state)
    out[key] = value
    return out

lessons.title: 4. Derived Selector (Practice)
lessons.description: Implement `select_active(items)` returning those with active True.
lessons.solution_code:
def select_active(items):
    return [it for it in items if it.get('active')]
